testCase.name: [local] S15 Step 5 (gated): tap Generate, then reload, leave, lock the phone or background the app for 30 s and return — the note, a 'generating' state, or an explicit failure, never blank (web and phone; S21 merged here)

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-03 step 5 + ER 2; TFA-92592 AC 15 · “After step 5, the note is present or an explicit failure shows on return, never a blank screen or silence.”.

Bug N17 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S1 · no longer counted

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved). Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: the note is a server job; reload or leaving during Generate shows a generating state, then the note (dev: OAT-03/S15, TC-14/S07, S26, TC-21/S28 10/10, TC-17/S27).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S07, TC-14/S26, TC-25/S14, TC-21/S28, TC-17/S27

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S15 Step 5 (gated): tap Generate, then reload, leave, lock the phone or background the app for 30 s and return — the note, a 'generating' state, or an explicit failure, never blank (web and phone; S21 merged here)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Start Generate, then lock the phone, background the app, or reload the tab for 30 s and return: the note is present or an explicit failure shows, never a blank screen or silence; … (UAT OAT-03 step 5; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 2; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, each with an encounter dictation typed. Phone cells: an iOS and an Android build under the same rules as S20 (which builds and accounts may be used)

When Tap Generate Note & Finish, reload at once (or open another patient), wait 30 s, return to the chart and open Post-Round. Phone cells: tap Generate Note & Finish, lock the phone 30 s (iOS) / background the app 30 s (Android), unlock and return

Then The note is there; or a 'generating' state while it still runs, then the note; or an explicit failure with the dictation kept. Never an empty Post-Round tab with no state; the same on the phone, never a blank screen or silence

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Each web checkpoint mustContain the patient and one of: the note heading, 'generating', or the failure message; Post-Round with none of them = Fail. Phone cells: the tester's screenshot on return judged against Expected Result 2. Whether 'generating' alone passes is Q9. Gated: TFA-92592 AC 15 is not on main, so a Fail reports as Blocked. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S15

Step 5 (gated): tap Generate, then reload, leave, lock the phone or background the app for 30 s and return — the note, a 'generating' state, or an explicit failure, never blank (web and phone; S21 merged here)

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

PW, local stack, web cells (generateNote mocked at the socket, answered 8 s after it is asked). Hospital: Generate, reload at once (the request in flight), 30 s, Post-Round: FAILED — only 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button (B27): no note, no generating state, no failure; the dictation is kept (passed). Nursing Home: Generate, the chart's back arrow at once (no reload), 30 s on the list, reopen, Post-Round: passed (the page that started the call was still alive and saved the note). Judged U4 (TFA-92592 AC 15): failed on the reload cell. Phone cells (lock an iPhone 30 s, background the Android app 30 s) are device-only: not run (an emulator run on e02167f, dvc OAT-03/S20, kept the note after 30 s in the background with a scripted 25 s model wait). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.

Product issue: Reloading (or the app being killed) right after Generate leaves Post-Round blank apart from 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and a spinner that never stops; the note is gone and nothing says so.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: browser-events, outside-runner. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev newspec-c] passed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: passed → passed (passed) Dev (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Dataset rb1-gen-ac15 (new spec rb1-gen-ac15.spec.ts; Generate now sends the mutation noteJobs:request and the note is a server job, TFA-92592 #101). Hospital: Generate, rel…
